settings.label: Default channel
settings.help: The channel users land in, and the one the door creates on a board with no rooms yet. It cannot be left.

settings.label: Sound effects
settings.help: Clicks, joins and message tones. Off silences the door for everyone; each user can still mute their own.

settings.label: Sidebar width (columns)
settings.help: Minimum width of the channel list. It still grows to fit long channel names.

settings.label: Reconnect attempts
settings.help: How many times a user may retry after losing the connection before the door closes.
